text:
sasha: Heads-up — I started a rapid dev/staging bring-up for lumenx-3b-int8 on the alpha node pool. Need a minimal checklist and someone to run quick smoke prompts. Goal: basic correctness, safety pass, and perf baseline (median latency target <120ms/token for usual 2k prompts). Ping if you can take the run.

mike_ml: I can run the smoke set. Quick Q: which quant profile are we using? int8 per-channel (symmetric) or int8+act? Also, do we want an FP16 baseline run for comparison?

anja_infra: Pool is available. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-staging/models/lumenx/3b/int8/ and mounted to /models/lumenx/3b/int8 on devstg workers. Note: tokenizer process can spike memory; added 2GB swap on nodes to avoid early OOMs.

kevin_qa: I can do the canonical 12-prompt sanity suite (LM-CORE small). Will check for EM on the QA subset, hallucinations on summarization, and basic safety filter hits. Any script preferred?

sasha: Use quant config int8-channel-v2 (from redwood-optimize profiles). Yes run FP16 baseline from s3://redwood-staging/models/lumenx/3b/fp16/ for diffs. Use the inline safety filter (latest rules). Quick smoke command below — keep runs under 1m per prompt where possible.

mike_ml: Posting smoke prompt set (short):
- "What is the capital of France?" (factual)
- "Summarize the last paragraph of this document: <long-context>" (long-context summarization)
- "Solve: 17 * 24" (math small)
- "Rewrite: Make this more formal: 'hey, need this by tmrw'" (instruction-following)
- "Extract: list all APIs mentioned in the text" (extraction)

kevin_qa: Smoke-run command I used:
```
# smoke run (example)
python run_smoke.py \
  --model-path /models/lumenx/3b/int8 \
  --prompts smoke_prompts.json \
  --out smoke_out.json \
  --timeout 60 \
  --safety-filter inline
```
Include --fp16-baseline /models/lumenx/3b/fp16 for one comparison run.

lina_prod: Add a routing policy test: ensure that if int8 avg latency >200ms for a 5-minute window, requests route to fp16 fallback automatically. Also verify token-level cost estimates on the console.

deploy-bot: deploy: container start lumenx-int8:2027-03-20 on node-alpha-3 (task abc123), logs streaming. :rocket:

kevin_qa: Initial results (first pass): answered 12/12 prompts. Metrics: median latency 95ms/token, p95 180ms/token, CPU tokenize spikes observed on long-context cases. EM on QA subset = 0.73. Two hallucination cases on long-context summarization (both where prompt had truncated context). Safety filter: 0 hits. Compared to FP16 baseline: fp16 median 92ms/token, p95 160ms/token, EM 0.76.

sasha: Great, thanks. Action items:
- mike_ml: investigate long-context summarization regressions (chunking strategy + KV cache behavior) — low-priority quant artifact?
- anja_infra: can we increase tokenizer memory cap for long-run jobs or pre-tokenize long-contexts in pipeline?
- kevin_qa: expand the sanity set to 50 prompts including long docs and hallucination probes; re-run overnight.
- lina_prod: prepare canary routing config for automatic fp16 fallback if p95 >200ms.

mike_ml: I suspect chunking + tokenization differences after quantization. Will try two fixes: 1) force model to use prefetching of KV cache; 2) apply sliding-window summarization in the client. Will report back with diffs.

anja_infra: I bumped node swap, and created a temporary job class with +1GB mem for tokenizer. Also added a lightweight collector for tokenize-time to help debug.

kevin_qa: Setting up the expanded 50-prompt overnight run now. Will post summary (EM, hallucination cases, latency histograms) tomorrow morning.

lina_prod: If overnight looks stable (no new regressions and latency within target), we can promote lumenx-3b-int8 to devstg-canary for 24h monitoring. Otherwise keep in quarantine.

sasha: Perfect. Thanks everyone — let's keep this thread for updates. Short status pings only after initial run. :white_check_mark:
